behavior.arguments: rdi = struct base; rdx points at a 32-bit index; rsi points at a control struct read at [rsi] (base), [rsi+0x20] (offset), and [rsi+0x28] (flag byte). No other argument is read.

branch_targets.jae: span-end check: when span_start + span_len >= cursor (unsigned, wrapping sum), jump to ret unchanged; otherwise fall through to the span-start check.
branch_targets.jb: span-start check: when [rsi] < span_start (unsigned), jump to ret unchanged; otherwise fall through to the field rewrite.
branch_targets.jne: flag gate: when byte [rsi+0x28] != 0, jump to ret unchanged; otherwise fall through to the index computation. All conditional transfers target the single ret.

edges.flag_set: when byte [rsi+0x28] != 0, nothing changes regardless of the other inputs.
edges.start_below_base: when span_start < base, nothing changes even if the span end is below the cursor; e.g. base 0x1000, offset 0x200, span_start 0x800, span_len 0x100 leaves the field at 0x100.
edges.sum_above_cursor: when span_start + span_len > cursor, nothing changes; e.g. base 0x1000, offset 0x200, span_start 0x1000, span_len 0x300 leaves the field at 0x300. This is the scout-correction edge: the round-20 scout note described this case as a write, but the jae to ret says otherwise.
edges.sum_below_cursor_write: when span_start + span_len < cursor and span_start >= base, the field is rewritten to offset + span_len; e.g. base 0x1000, offset 0x200, span_start 0x1000, span_len 0x100 writes 0x300.
edges.sum_equals_cursor: when span_start + span_len == cursor, nothing changes; e.g. base 0x1000, offset 0x200, span_start 0x1000, span_len 0x200 leaves the field at 0x200.
edges.wrapping_sum: when span_start is near 2^64, the span end wraps before the unsigned compare; e.g. base 0x1000, offset 0x200, span_start 2^64-0x10, span_len 0x20 wraps the sum to 0x10, which is below the cursor, so the field is written to 0x220.
edges.zero: when the flag byte is clear, the index is 0, base and offset are 0, and span_start and span_len are 0, the sum equals the cursor (0) and nothing changes.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; one flag gate (cmpb + jne to ret), two bounds checks (jae and jb, both to ret), zero calls, zero other jumps; a single ret.
behavior.return_rule: Let flag = byte [rsi+0x28], idx = [rdx] (32-bit load, zero-extended), elem = [rdi] + idx * 112 (idx * 7, then << 4, wrapping), cursor = [rsi] + [rsi+0x20] (wrapping), span_start = [elem+0x28], span_len = [elem+0x18]. If flag != 0, return with nothing changed. If (span_start + span_len) mod 2^64 >= cursor (unsigned), return unchanged. If span_start < [rsi] (unsigned), return unchanged. Otherwise [elem+0x18] = [rsi+0x20] + span_len (wrapping) and return. No other field is written on any path; the return value is not claimed.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

distinctions.packet_112: Packet #112 (0x4ea41e0 bounded scaled cursor advance) shares only the words 'cursor advance': different VA, different stride (112 vs 88), different rule (flag gate + two bounds checks + field rewrite vs min-clamp + cursor advance + remainder return), different fields. Byte-compare over the 54-byte overlap: 0/54 identical — not a twin.
distinctions.peer_981_gap: Peer PR #981's unwindless gap ends at 0x5631f00; this window is a separate FDE at 0x5293e00 with its own rule, not one of the peer's gap candidates.
distinctions.peer_lanes: Found in the round-20 general slice, not in any peer lane; the peer lanes themselves yielded zero rankable easy windows this round.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Zero R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in any .rela.* section name this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).

scout_correction: The round-20 scout note described the span-end gate as 'span_start + span_len <= cursor -> ret'. The bytes say otherwise: cmp %rdi,%r9 followed by jae to ret means ret when span_start + span_len >= cursor (unsigned), so the field is rewritten only when the sum is strictly below the cursor. The scout's other elements (FDE range, 71-byte body, 9 padding bytes, zero callers, zero slots, nearest claimed window) verified exactly.
